items.title: Alcimus
items.charge: Slandering Judas to the king; slaying sixty Asideans under a sworn peace; pulling down the wall of the inner court

items.title: Amaziah the priest of Bethel
items.charge: Forbidding Amos to prophesy at the king's chapel; accusing him to Jeroboam of conspiracy

items.title: Ananias the high priest
items.charge: Commanding Paul to be smitten on the mouth, contrary to the law, while sitting to judge him by the law

items.title: Caiaphas and the council
items.charge: Seeking false witness against Christ; condemning him by night; delivering him to the Gentiles; forbidding the apostles; stoning Stephen

items.title: Eli and his sons
items.charge: Corrupt priesthood; a father who would not restrain it

items.title: Eliashib and Tobiah the Ammonite
items.charge: Lodging an Ammonite enemy in a chamber of the house of God; a priest's house allied to Sanballat

items.title: Jason the high priest
items.charge: Buying the priesthood; setting up a Greek gymnasium; drawing his countrymen to heathen customs

items.title: Jehoiada the priest
items.charge: Hiding the king's son six years from Athaliah; making a covenant between the Lord, the king, and the people; doing good in Israel, both toward God and toward his house

items.title: Jeroboam son of Nebat
items.charge: Two golden calves; priests of the lowest of the people; a feast devised of his own heart

items.title: Korah, Dathan, and Abiram
items.charge: Rebellion against God-appointed authority

items.title: Mattathias
items.charge: Zealous for the law: refusing the king's commandment at Modin, and executing the apostate on the altar as Phinehas did Zambri

items.title: Menelaus
items.charge: Buying the priesthood over Jason; stealing the temple vessels; procuring the murder of Onias; bribing his way past the king's judgment

items.title: Micah's idols and the tribe of Dan
items.charge: A house of gods, a hired Levite, and a tribe that stole both

items.title: Nadab and Abihu
items.charge: Offering strange fire not commanded

items.title: Obed-edom the Gittite
items.charge: Keeping the ark of God in his house three months, after it had killed Uzzah

items.title: Onias the high priest
items.charge: Godliness and hatred of wickedness, so that the laws were kept very well and the city lived in peace

items.title: Pashur the son of Immer
items.charge: Smiting the prophet and putting him in the stocks; prophesying lies

items.title: Phinehas
items.charge: Zealous for his God at Peor; making an atonement for the children of Israel

items.title: Saul and Doeg at Nob
items.charge: Slaughter of the priests of the Lord on an informer's report

items.title: Simon the governor of the temple
items.charge: Betraying the temple treasury to the king out of a private quarrel; slandering Onias the high priest

items.title: The captivity of Judah
items.charge: Polluting the house of the Lord; mocking the messengers of God; refusing the Sabbath and the land's sabbaths

items.title: The congregation, the day after Korah
items.charge: Murmuring that Moses and Aaron had killed the people of the Lord

items.title: The priests of Bel
items.charge: Deceiving the king and the people with an idol that seemed to eat

items.title: The priests who despised the Name
items.charge: Offering polluted bread and blemished beasts; being partial in the law

items.title: The scribes and Pharisees
items.charge: Shutting up the kingdom against men; devouring widows' houses; tithing mint and omitting judgment, mercy and faith; whited sepulchres

items.title: The shepherds of Israel
items.charge: Feeding themselves and not the flock; scattering the sheep

items.title: The sons of Levi at the golden calf
items.charge: Answering, Who is on the Lord's side? and executing the sentence on their own brethren

items.title: The traders in the temple
items.charge: Making the house of prayer a den of thieves

items.title: Uzziah
items.charge: Entering the temple to burn incense, which belonged to the priests

items.title: Zacharias
items.charge: Not believing the words of the angel Gabriel, and asking for a sign

items.title: Zacharias and Elisabeth
items.charge: Both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless

items.title: Zerubbabel and Joshua the high priest
items.charge: Obeying the voice of the Lord by Haggai; rising up and working on the house of the Lord
